name: Harrowmere
description: A grey town of drystone and slate on the northern moor, older than the castle and not much more cheerful.

gate.name: The Moor Gate
gate.description: A low gate in a drystone wall. The moor road comes in from the east, and the town huddles inside, grey roofs under a grey sky.

street.name: The Narrow Street
street.description: A cobbled street no wider than a cart, with a shop door on each side and a cold wind funnelling down the middle.

smithy.name: The Smithy
smithy.description: A hot, low room that smells of iron. Blades and plate hang from the rafters on chains.

provisions.name: The Provisions Store
provisions.description: A cramped store of baskets, bundles and jars, lit by a single candle.

west.failure_message: The door of the shuttered house is locked. A brass key would answer it.

inn.name: The Grey Heron
inn.description: A smoky inn with three tables and a single, very old dog. The landlady keeps the beds aired in spite of the damp.

elder_house.name: The Elder's House
elder_house.description: A low house crowded with books and drying herbs. An old man sits in a chair too large for him.

locked_house.name: The Shuttered House
locked_house.description: A shuttered house whose owner has gone, leaving three chests against the back wall and a great deal of dust.

graveyard.name: The Hill Graveyard
graveyard.description: A walled burial ground on the slope above the town, thick with cold grass and leaning stones. At its upper end an iron-bound hatch stands in the ground, half open. A stair leads down.
